caption: Remediation Outcome
description: The Remediation Outcome object describes the aggregate outcome of remediating a target resource, including counts of resolved, severity-reduced, and unchanged findings, and per-finding before/after detail.
name: remediation_outcome

contributing_findings.description: The per-finding detail showing the current and projected state for each contributing finding.

resolved_findings_count.description: The number of findings that will be fully resolved by remediating this target.

severity_reduction_findings_count.description: The number of findings that will have reduced severity after remediating this target.

severity_unchanged_findings_count.description: The number of findings that will remain at the same severity after remediating this target.
